title: Introducing Aardvark: OpenAI’s agentic security researcher
summary_lines: OpenAI introduces Aardvark, an AI-powered security researcher that autonomously finds, validates, and helps fix software vulnerabilities at scale. The system is in private beta—sign up to join early testing.
